activity_b.text: Good morning, Nimal. Nice to meet you.
Good morning, Madam. How are you today?
Please relax and take a seat.
Quite good. I’m looking forward to talking to you about my career.
Let’s begin with something simple.
Tell me, what do you know about our company?
Last night I read about your company on the Internet.
I saw that you installed a new power-distribution system in Kilinochchi and that you focus strongly on safety and electrical standards.
I also liked the way you use modern testing equipment.
I’m glad you checked it.
Before we talk about your skills, tell me—what do you like most in the electrical field?
Honestly, Madam, I like diagnosing faults and restoring power.
When we check circuits or repair a panel, I can see immediate results.
I also enjoy working with a team.
That’s a good attitude.
And what tasks are you good at?
I am good at wiring small systems and organising cables neatly.
During my training, I installed switches, tested continuity, and helped the instructor label distribution boards.
And what technical skills do you have?
I know how to read simple wiring diagrams, measure voltage, and use tools like multimeters, wire strippers, and test pens.
Last month, I repaired a loose connection in the workshop panel.
We sometimes use digital insulation testers.
Are you familiar with them?
I am not familiar with them, Madam, but I can read about them on the Internet.
That’s how I learned more about surge protection.
Excellent.
Finally, why should we select you?
Because I learn fast, I work diligently, and I’m always ready to support the team.
Well said, Nimal. We’ll contact you soon.
